allBandsCoverage.sameBand: Enlarged mesh boxes have half width 2*ell^-6; intersecting indices differ by at most 4 in each coordinate. Modulo 5 therefore separates distinct indices.
allBandsCoverage.oppositeSigns: The final binary color separates the two signs of the same slow box.
allBandsCoverage.farBands: Actual dyadic cutoffs have disjoint q supports for |ell-ellPrime|>2; the proof conservatively separates all differences through 4.

chainRule.derivation: Jg*v_r=Lambda_g*v_r; Jg*v_t=T_g*v_t. d_eta(v)=1/c_i. The fast time coefficient c_i cancels; slow derivatives hold Yi fixed.

chain.basis: v_r dot v_t=0; |v_r|^2=|v_t|^2=Dgeom. These are the exact original Q(sqrt2) identities bound to the retained basis roots.
chain.radial: xi=(v_r dot offset)/Dgeom, eta=(v_t dot offset)/Dgeom. Differentiating the original Yi in R gives xi_R=a(R), v_R=0, where a is actual AD of the retained radial primitive.
chain.axial: Yi is independent of Z. sqrt(Q)/Q^D=Q^h=epsilon, so the normalized axial derivative is epsilon*partial_Z.
chain.time: Yi_T=-Q*Tg^i*v_t; xi_T=0 and v_T=-Q*Tg^i/ci. ci=Tg^i*Q^(1+h), so (-epsilon)*v_T=1 exactly on Q>0. Hence normalized physical time is -epsilon*partial_T+partial_v.
chain.positivePowerRule: Q=exp(-ell*log2)>0. exp((1+h)logQ)=Q*exp(h*logQ); no decimal Q, log approximation or h=0 substitution is used.
chain.nearestLift: The integer copy is locally constant on each active source rectangle. Its half width is <3*r0<1/2, so the original cutoff support avoids the nearest-lift boundary. No derivative of integer reselection is used.

geometry.components: Cartesian x,y,z after the exact cylindrical basis rotation
geometry.physicalCoordinates: r=sqrt(Q)*R, z=Q^D*Z, t=1-Q*T; x=r*cos(theta), y=r*sin(theta). Q and all labels are frozen.
geometry.derivativeScales: space:Q^-1/2, time:Q^-1-h, applied to the already scaled velocity Q^-A. Pressure uses Q^-2A.

domain.sourceDomain: The selected fixed band; Xplus<X_rep<Xb and Xplus<X<Xb, eta_rep,eta in[-1,1], s_rep,s in[1/2,2], same slow box distance<=4/S^3. Representatives and rounded labels are frozen for slow differentiation.
domain.restriction: Open terminal chart with Xplus<X,Xrep<Xb, 1/2<s,srep<2, |eta|,|etaRep|<1, frozen representative and the same source slow box.
domain.positiveWeights: Consumed from the private actual selected small-q terminal certificate; no caller positivity assumption is substituted.
domain.boundary: At eta=+/-1 use inward finite jets only; no T<0 heat extension. This third-jet certificate is restricted to the open chart. Flat endpoints and cross-label gluing are separate.
domain.norms: Exact parameter-dependent FTC integral envelopes of actual M_alpha and B_alpha and their generated v derivatives. Initial and dummy-time substitutions use fully specified shares whose value and v derivative materialize to the original body. They are locally bounded on compact interior slow neighborhoods; no common all-band C4/Gaussian or numerical bound is inferred.
domain.initial: The original w(0)=(1,0), fixed left0, fixed Ls and frozen carrier/P are actually checked for slow independence.
domain.originalSource: The historical canonical c_n background is used. A separately strengthened a_n background is not silently identified with it.
domain.physical: The same selected small-q terminal member on Xplus<X<Xb, Xplus<Xrep<Xb, 1/2<s,srep<2, |eta|,|etaRep|<1 and the same fixed slow box. R>0.
domain.fastSupport: The original chi(xi) and psi(v) remain. Outside |xi|<r0 or 0<v<Ls the explicit zero guards precede Volterra evaluation. The fast cutoff is flat at those boundaries.
domain.nearestLift: Each supported rectangle is strictly inside its nearest-integer lift. Its label is frozen during differentiation; no derivative of floor or relabeling is used.
domain.regularity: The original coefficients and full H/target/positive square-root weights are smooth on this open terminal chart. The source-bound local uniform differentiated Volterra convergence and the ODE right hand side give the fast v jets used here.
domain.slowEdges: No zero extension at Xplus is inserted, and no value or derivative at y=0 is used. Slow stress boundary gluing and uniform cross-label estimates are separate.

rows.physicalOrdering: Original real harmonic potential -> Cartesian rotation -> full independent slow/fast derivative operators -> original Q scales -> actual fixed-label rectangle -> original physical Yi.
